- Single law reproduces exp579 reference (b_NLS=1.097 vs published 1.104; MLE 1.123) but left-decile prediction **.1415** sits below measured **.1620** [.1547,.1695] → tension real.
- Two-component T(x)=A(1+x)^{−b_bulk}+K(1+x)^{−b_edge}: **ΔAICc −37.33** (bar >6), LRT stat 41.59 df2 **p=9.3×10⁻¹⁰** (bar <0.01); bootstrap-stable b_bulk=.573 [.412,.767], w_edge=.086 [.064,.108]; fitted left-decile .1617 [boot .1557,.1695] **covers** observed .1620; bootstrap median ΔAICc +60 across resamples.
- Controls: **ΔAICc +4.3** (two-comp worse), w≈1.2×10⁻⁴ → no kernel in controls.

### Boundary censoring discovered + settled
Registered fit pinned delta=b_edge−b_bulk at the implementation ceiling 10.000 (registered degeneracy rule covered only the LOWER bound; boundary solutions not forbidden) → read b_edge ≥ ~10.6. POST-HOC cap-40 refit: INTERIOR unpinned optimum b_edge=22.54 (delta_pinned_at_40 false), improvement GROWS (**ΔAICc −42.5, p=6.9×10⁻¹¹**), left-decile CI still covers → ceiling was conservative CENSORING, verdict cap-robust. Honest statement: b_edge ≥ ~10.4–11.1 across caps; exact value unidentified near-spike (cap40 boot CI [11.1,20.5,41.0]).

56% of SSR improvement in the FIRST DECILE alone, ~0% (−0.5%) at the known u*≈0.65 hump zone, −3.2% right → genuinely edge-driven, orthogonal to paper 232's geometric-window feature. Left-half refit independently confirms (single steepens to b=1.798; ΔAICc 16.8, p=2.6×10⁻⁵; 47.5% again first-decile).

### Consequence
The positional hit profile of v_j=j²−N is **FLAT-BULK + NARROW LEFT-EDGE SPIKE**, NOT a pure power law; the single −1.104 law is RETIRED as final FORM (retained as bulk summary); kernel-refined profile becomes the canonical description — a pure power law is now KNOWN-WRONG at the edge (falsifiable constraint for any downstream shape model).

Paper 234's tension premise quoted measured edge fraction ".2346" (z=10.08 stratified): NOT reproducible from the canonical npz under left-decile-only definition (.1620 measured); per-N equal-mean .1609 / log-normalization / (p−jlo)/jlo / inverse-n weighting variants also miss, and .2346 lies outside even the two-comp prediction CI. ## GAP-L8 CLOSED — k-TAXONOMY (round-77 #2, paper 224, theory deliverable)

Closes draft items L8 + O5 of paper 219's roadmap ("pin exp563's k\* definition ... paper must name which"). No new physics run; definitional/taxonomy result.

### Three definitions
1. **k_pin = ⌈log₂W⌉** — gain-saturation point: marginal gain exactly zero, support fully pinned. Paper 212's "k\*=⌈log₂W⌉" retro-reads as this. NEVER an optimum.
2. **k_opt^cost = argmin_k[k+(W/2^k+1)/2]** — T2 census total-cost stop. Dyadic W ⇒ tie set {log₂W−2, log₂W−1}, V\*=log₂W+½ EXACT (W=2..4096); continuous location log₂W−1.5288.
3. **k_opt^econ(T₀,c_q) = log₂((T₀−1)·ln2/c_q)** — net-economics optimum, queries paid c_q against the MEASURED baseline T₀.

### Exact identity
E(k;T₀,1)=1+k+(T₀−1)/2^k ≡ V(k; W=2(T₀−1))+½ pointwise ⇒ **k_opt^econ(T₀,1) == k_opt^cost(2(T₀−1))** (identical argmin sets AND locations). Factor-2 bookkeeping: T2 prices residual at half remaining support, exp563 charges full expected scan anchored at measured T̄₀. Unconverted same-number inputs differ by EXACTLY +1.000 query — paper 219's "+~1" note confirmed at exactly +1.

### Numerical verification (`gapL8_check.py`, <2 s, ALL PASS)
- Census offsets {−2,−1} rel log₂W, dyadic V\*=log₂W+½ exact for all dyadic W ≤ 4096.
- Identity max abs error < 1e-9; naive same-anchor shift exactly +1 on discrete argmin sets.
- exp563 stored rows reproduce: balanced T̄₀=1072.425 → pred 9.536549 (=recorded), argmin 10 (=recorded); unbalanced T̄₀=286205.89 → pred 17.597922 (=recorded), argmin 18 (=recorded). Matched-anchor census gives same unique {10}/{18}.
- Pin never coincides with either optimum: gap ∈ {1,2} for every W ≤ 4096.

### Verdicts on coincidence
Only (k_opt^cost, k_opt^econ) ever coincide — after anchor conversion. k_pin NEVER coincides with either; conflating them overstates the work-optimal budget (exp563 balanced: 20 vs 10).

### Naming rule adopted
Bare "k\*" BANNED in future papers; must expand to k_pin / k_opt^cost (with W) / k_opt^econ(T₀,c_q) (with anchor and price). Draft T2 already complies.

### Verification scope (disclosed)
Definitional result; verification = own check script ALL PASS + exact reproduction of previously-recorded exp563/T2-census values from stored rows (cross-validates against the existing record). NO separate adversarial verifier run — scope judgment, disclosed.

Exp 572 · paper 217 · assessment v324 · script ResearchOutput/scripts/2026-08-24-round74/exp572_ma1_signed.py · seed 572 · wall 6.96 s.

**Question.** Paper 213/exp566 closed the MAGNITUDE route of MA-1 effectivity (|L(1,χ)| does not predict |AP deviations|, R²=0.019) but preserved the SIGNED route: do signs of character-twisted prime-count deviations align with signs predicted by computable character data? A yes would be the first computable handle on AP-deviation structure.

**Key structural disclosure** (post-smoke, pre-full-data): L(1,χ)>0 for EVERY real non-principal χ (class-number formula) ⇒ sign(w)≡+1 identically (n_cells_w_negative=0 at full scale), so registered criterion C1 reduces exactly to Pr[c_χ>0] and could only fire if prime twists were majority-positive. Working identity asserted exact (<1e-9): c_χ = Σ_a d_a·χ(a) = Σ_{p≤x} χ(p); the uniform-li theory term vanishes identically by orthogonality, so signed L(1,χ) is the only computable x-independent theory weight.

**Design.** x=2²⁶ full (π(x)=3,957,809); 287 moduli (squarefree [3,300] ∪ primes [307,997]); 491 real-char cells; 86,882 unit classes; machinery verbatim from exp566 (class-number exact D<0 |D|≤400, truncated-L otherwise, median rel err 1.8e-5); CP95 intervals + within-modulus d-shuffle null (2000 draws — MEANINGFUL here unlike exp566 since sign(c) is not permutation-invariant in a).

**Result H0 — both criteria fail, both levels.** Cell agreement 15.07% over 491 cells (74 agree), CP95 [0.1202, 0.1855], circular-sum z=−52.72 (C2 needs >3). Class level 48.74% over 86,882 classes, CP95 [0.4841, 0.4907], permutation z=−7.74 — significantly BELOW chance (mild anti-alignment). Breakdowns all CIs wholly below 50%: prime-modulus quadratics 26.9% (167), product chars ω≥2 8.95% (324), exact-L 12.8% (226), truncated-L 17.0% (265), drop-|w|<1e-3 robustness unchanged.

**Named byproduct** (labeled exploratory, not pre-registered): prime twists NEGATIVE in 84.7% of cells (CP95 [0.8123, 0.8779]; smoke x=2²² read 91.7%) — the universal Chebyshev/Rubinstein–Sarnak low bias, independently confirmed inside the lab's own AP-deviation machinery at x=2²⁶. Deviation signs are one-directional across moduli and zero-driven, NOT carried by any computable L-value — precisely why no L-based predictor can track them.

**Ledger.** (1) m=6 orthogonality assert exposed the raw-primitive-twist ±1 correction for primes p|m, p∤cond(χ) (max corr 3, 0 sign flips induced — disclosed, not corrected); (2) class-z scale mix-up fixed (−310 → single-scale −7.74); (3) exp566's 'within-modulus shuffle vacuous' caveat verified NOT to transfer here.

**Barrier framing.** Closes barrier-map residual 'MA-1 effectivity' as a named question: no computable criterion via quadratic-character structure on either route (magnitude paper 213, sign here) at toy scale; the averaging identity's effective scope remains non-computable from N; consistent with barriers 4/5. No breakthrough.

**Paper 215 · exp 568 · round-74 #6 · assessment v322**

VERDICT: **H3 CONFIRMED (strong form)** — H1/H0 moot-by-absence.

Paper 159 headlines an ECM self-destruction wall: "when B1 ≳ min(p,q), every Hasse-window order divides lcm(1..B1), all curves degenerate simultaneously, uncapped E[T] infinite", with a validity edge B1 ≲ min(p,q)/2. Exp568 tests that boundary under outcome-separated accounting {found_p, found_q, dead, nothing}.

**Design.** Bitlen-26 q≫p stratum (generator nextprime(3p+U[1,200))), n_N=40/cell, grid B1/p ∈ {0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 0.9, 1.05} × arms B2/B1 ∈ {1 (control), 4, 16}; guarded affine EC ops reused VERBATIM from exp488_true_ecm.py (validated there 10/10 ladder + 100/100 mod-12); true-lcm stage-1 schedule; NEW true difference-stage stage-2. Pre-registration verbatim before any data: H1 slope(log w* vs log(B2/B1)) CI covers 1 / H0 covers 0 / MIXED; H3 ADDED after reading the mechanism sentence, BEFORE data (timing disclosed): the wall is a detection/accounting artifact — gcd(den,N)==N 'dead' events or missing p-vs-q separation — not method failure.

**Results (600 trials).**
- ZERO 'dead' outcomes in the entire grid.
- Success 1.000 in every cell at B1/p ≥ 0.25; **6/6 cells at 1.000 at B1/p = 0.9 AND 1.05** — exactly where paper 159 records uncapped E[T] infinite.
- Only misses: two low-edge cells at B1/p = 0.125 (arm-4 0.875, arm-16 0.95), all misses 'nothing', never 'dead'.
- No w* exists anywhere → H1/H0 never arm.

**Mechanism (pre-data note, vindicated).** B1 ≥ p+1+2√p ⇒ every Hasse-window order n ≤ B1 ⇒ every prime power l^e ‖ n has l^e ≤ B1 ⇒ n | lcm(1..B1) ⇒ [L]P = O mod p on EVERY curve ⇒ first guarded inversion with vanishing denominator returns gcd = p: GUARANTEED SUCCESS, not death. Simultaneous degeneracy mod q impossible for q ≫ B1. "All curves degenerate" can only have read as death if accounting conflated gcd=p wins with gcd=N losses or lacked p-vs-q separation.

**Structural insight (ledger-grade).** Guarded-affine accounting carries a scale-independent random-collision baseline ≈ 1 − exp(−c·B1/p) (#ops ~ 1.44·B1, per-op hit ~1/p): ~17% predicted at B1/p = 0.125 vs 68% observed found-p share (collision-luck + order-divisibility mixed). Any historical success/E[T] accounting that did not separate collision-hits from order-hits could have manufactured the wall sentence. Attacks the barrier-map residual item **MA-1 effectivity**: is there a COMPUTABLE per-modulus criterion for when the MA-1 averaging assumption (which-factor blindness as identity, papers 93/102/132) is realized? If AP-deviation magnitude were governed by quadratic-character L-values, one would exist. Pre-registered carrier: D(m) = max_a |π(x;m,a) − E|/√E on P(m) = Σ|L(1,χ)| over nontrivial real characters mod m; H1 R² > 0.8 ⇒ criterion armed; H0 R² < 0.5 ⇒ honest negative.

**Pre-registered verdict rules evaluated verbatim → NULL-HONEST-NEGATIVE at TWO scales.**

**(1) Registered stage A (x = 2^26 full, no shrinkage).** π(x) = 3,957,809, 287 moduli (squarefree [3,300] ∪ primes [307,997]), wall 9.3 s: log D ~ −0.0767·log P, slope CI95 (−0.136, −0.015), **R² = 0.0187** [bootstrap 0.0007–0.065] — slope slightly NEGATIVE, opposite the effectivity story. Partial R² controlling log φ(m) = **0.0008** ⇒ residual association purely a φ(m) size effect. Secondary chi² readout agrees (R² = 0.025). Control cross-modulus pairing permutation (2000 draws) collapses to null (mean 0.0033 / max 0.0435); disclosed spec deviation: literal within-modulus count permutation is VACUOUS for max/χ² readouts (permutation-invariant).

**(2) Final scaled artifact B (x = 2^28, π = 14,630,843, 2489 moduli dense 2..1500 + primes beyond, wall 247.7 s).** Primary per-m carrier **R² = 0.0785 → NULL**; cell-level secondary y ~ log(1/L), 1902 discriminant cells: R² = 0.00052, theory-signed slope B = −0.034 [−0.101, +0.033] — not even positive. Baseline size control: OBS ~ log m alone explains **R² = 0.790** — deviation magnitude is modulus-size-dominated; character-L mass adds nothing after size.

**(3) Verification.** Exact class-number path validated: L(1, χ₋₃) = π/(3√3) exact (h(−3)=1, w=6); truncated series calibrated on 226 overlap discriminants, median rel err 1.8e-5; final-run truncation quality real-share median 8.7e-4, worst rel err 8.2e-2.

> **SCOPING CAVEAT (prominent):** the registered readout D(m) is **SIGN-BLIND** and the predictor uses |L(1,χ)| magnitudes — this bounds the MAGNITUDE route only. Signed character-alignment analysis is the required follow-up BEFORE killing the L-value route.

**Barrier framing:** H0 here does NOT weaken the barrier program — it honestly bounds one computable-criterion route at toy scale. MA-1 stays axiomatic at practical scale; "MA-1 effectivity" stays an OPEN gap item.

Resolves the hint-pricing tension between paper 138's linear no-synergy law and the rounds-70/71 "sequential hints compound" observation by isolating **adaptivity** (posterior conditioning between queries). n = 800 bitlen-40 semiprimes in two strata (600 BALANCED ρ ∈ [1, 1.01] / 200 UNBALANCED ρ ∈ [7.5, 8.5]), k ∈ {0,1,2,3,6,9,12,14,16,20,24}, idealized truthful `p ≤ t?` oracle, downstream Fermat-order scan priced in divisibility tests; arms ADAPT (bisection) / NONADAPT (uniform battery) / ADAPTQ/NONADAPTQ (draw-law-calibrated) / SHAM (cost gate).

**Pre-registered verdict rules evaluated verbatim → COMPOUND-CONFIRMED-HALVING-FAIL** (the UNBALANCED stratum alone reads GEOMETRIC-COMPOUND-ISOLATION-CAPPED — every prediction passes there including the strict slope).

**(1) Compounding real + superlinear + pure adaptivity (H1a/H1c CONFIRMED).** s_adapt(12)/s_adapt(3) = 165.2× unbalanced / 20.8× balanced (CIs exclude linear 4×); premium over the matched fixed battery at k = 12 = **239.5× [220.1, 261.0]** unbalanced / **20.8× [19.5, 22.3]** balanced, with r(1) = **1.00 EXACTLY** in all four pairs — nothing to adapt to at one query.

**(2) Hard isolation cap, zero barrier events (H1b CONFIRMED).** 100% of N pinned at k = 20 = ⌈log₂ W⌉; s(≥20) = T₀ exactly (1072.43 balanced / 2.862e5 unbalanced); max s ≤ T₀ × 1.01 everywhere → NO barrier event. Pin sits at the integer-bits cap above the prime-isolation bound ≈ 17 — barriers 4/8 UPHELD and now PRICED: external position info pays ISOLATION-COST per query.

**(3) Halving slope (the FAIL clause).** Aligned A10 test: −0.6589 PASS unbalanced; −0.5836 FAIL balanced, 16% off −ln2 (band-entry phase correlation; the width-halving law itself is EXACT: V2a 720 deterministic steps, V2b closed form vs dense grid 1.9%).

**(4) HEADLINE SURPRISE (ledger catch A5).** Balanced semiprimes pin min(p,q) against √N → a uniform FIXED battery carries **LITERALLY ZERO BITS** (s ≡ 1.00 exactly at every k ≤ 24 across all 600 N): non-adaptive batteries are waste-proof in the balanced stratum, and the adaptivity premium grows from exactly 1 into the hundreds.

**Net economics (H3 CONFIRMED).** k_opt = 10/18 measured vs log₂((T₀−1)·ln2/c_q) = 9.54/17.60 predicted; s_net_max = 89.0 / 14245. SHAM gate PASSED both strata (never helps, never inflates).

**RECONCILIATION — one pricing structure, two faces.** Paper 138's linear no-synergy pricing holds for NON-adaptive batteries (zero usable bits ⇒ zero speedup, exactly as the balanced collapse shows); sequential ADAPTIVE hints compound superlinearly but saturate EXACTLY at the isolation-cost ceiling. New hint-taxonomy entry: adaptive sequential hints price geometrically up to isolation cost. This resolves the tension flagged when rounds 70–71 noted "sequential hints COMPOUND" vs paper 138's linearity.

## NET-83 — limited-memory axis, round 33 (paper 165, ResearchOutput/exp_net83_integration.py, /tmp/net83.log)

**Verdict name: THE-INTEGRATION-IS-SUPER-ADDITIVE.**

### Result
The integration test combining GPTQ 4-bit group-128 weights with top-k attention:

| arm | retained | CE |
|---|---|---|
| full fp32 | 1.0000 | 2.697 |
| attn k=16 only | 0.9768 | 2.774 |
| attn k=20 only | 0.9803 | 2.755 |
| attn k=24 only | 0.9851 | 2.742 |
| GPTQ4 alone | 0.9081 | 3.015 |
| **GPTQ4 + k=16** | **0.8598** | **3.220** |
| **GPTQ4 + k=20** | **0.8707** | **3.180** |
| **GPTQ4 + k=24** | **0.8772** | **3.155** |

At k=16: expected additive degradation = 2.3% (attention) + 9.2% (quantization) = 11.5%. Actual combined = 14.0%. The extra 2.5% is the INTERACTION COST.

- **P1 REFUTED**: NOT sub-additive
- **P2 CONFIRMED**: super-additive — sparse attention AMPLIFIES quantization noise
- **P3 REFUTED**: the axes are NOT independent

### Mechanism
(1) Quantized key vectors project differently, changing which keys pass the top-k threshold.
(2) Selected keys' values carry quantization error that the sparse weighted sum cannot average away.

### Engineering consequence
Budget tables must include an INTERACTION PENALTY when both optimizations are active. A 4-bit model with k=24 attention is NOT equivalent to a 4-bit model plus a 24-key cache.

### Debug transparency
SEVEN debug iterations before recording; SIX bugs caught by sanity gates including a critical runner-layers reference bug that silently evaluated the wrong model.

Now 84 network experiments. Assessment v84. Paper 165.
title: NET-83: THE-INTEGRATION-IS-SUPER-ADDITIVE — GPTQ4+top-k degrades WORSE than sum of parts (14.0% vs expected 11.5%); sparse attention amplifies quantization noise

## NET-74 — limited-memory axis, round 25 (paper 159, ResearchOutput/exp_net74_attnstructure.py, /tmp/net74.log)

**Verdict name: TOP8-MASS-IS-THE-STRONGEST-STRUCTURAL-PREDICTOR.**

### Result
Three structural quantities per domain (5 domains, 3 sampled layers, 12 windows @ctx=512):

| domain | entropy | top-8 mass | head agreement | k\*@512 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| code | 3.798 | 0.488 | 0.083 | **12** |
| prose-en | 3.801 | 0.488 | 0.082 | **16** |
| math | 3.615 | **0.526** | 0.086 | **16** |
| prose-de | 3.752 | 0.502 | 0.080 | **20** |
| prose-fr | 3.864 | **0.473** | 0.079 | **>24** |

Spearman: entropy↔k\* = −0.60; top8↔k\* = **+0.80**; headvar↔k\* = −0.40.

- **P1 PARTIAL**: entropy anticorrelates (right sign) but below the −0.7 threshold.
- **P2 CONFIRMED**: top-8 mass is the strongest correlate (+0.80 > 0.7).
- **P3 REFUTED**: cross-head agreement ~8% everywhere — constant, not differentiator.

### The mechanism finding
The POSITIVE sign means domains with MORE mass in their top-8 have HIGHER knees: the knee is set by the RESIDUAL spread after the top keys are captured, not by how concentrated the peak is. The mechanism lives in the TAIL of the attention distribution — how the non-top mass decays determines whether a small budget suffices. Head diversity is constant across all domains and cannot explain any part of the variation.

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — three horns pre-stated incl. the refuted P3; (b) clean — first structural mechanism test; (c) confronted — 5 domains, 3 sampled layers, n=4 stated; (d) clean; (e) deterministic; (f) clean — ALL_DONE_NET74 (cosmetic error after data); (g) fair — identical methodology across domains; (h) DIRECT.

### Next
Tail-shape analysis (Pareto vs exponential decay per domain); sub-20 addendum @2048; 0.5B @4096; 7B cell.

## NET-73 — limited-memory axis, round 26 (paper 158, ResearchOutput/exp_net73_tpw.py, /tmp/net73.log)

**Verdict name: TOKENIZATION-DENSITY-DOES-NOT-EXPLAIN-THE-DOMAIN-SHIFT.**

### Result
Tokens-per-word across 5 domains (Qwen's own BPE, 5000-word samples) correlated with known knees:

| domain | TPW | k\*@512 | expected from TPW |
|---|---|---|---|
| code | **1.950** | **12** | should be HIGHEST ✗ |
| prose-de | 1.885 | 20 | second-highest ✓ |
| prose-fr | 1.246 | **>32** | should be near-English ✗ |
| math | 1.214 | 16 | near-English ✓ |
| prose-en | 1.173 | 16 | lowest ✓ |

Spearman ρ = **−0.40** (wrong sign); linear fit R² = **0.004**.

- **P1 REFUTED**: rank correlation is negative, not ≥0.9.
- **P2 REFUTED**: R² is zero, not ≥0.8.
- **P3 CONFIRMED decisively**: TPW is insufficient — the mechanism is NOT tokenization density.

French extended grid: k\*(fr@512) ≤ 32 (the knee exists, just far above the original ceiling).

### The law
The strongest counterexample kills the tokenization hypothesis: code has 1.66× English's TPW yet needs FEWER keys; French has ~1.07× English's TPW yet needs ≥2× more keys. The domain mechanism is NOT surface-level token counting — it is the RELATIONAL/SEMANTIC structure of attention patterns within each domain. NET-58/69 already bound those explanations as relational, not intrinsic to key identity.

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — three horns pre-stated incl. two refuted; (b) clean — first mechanism-test for the domain shift; (c) confronted — 5 domains, 5000-word samples, one tokenizer stated; (d) clean; (e) deterministic; (f) clean — ALL_DONE_NET73; (g) fair; (h) DIRECT.

## NET-59 — limited-memory axis, round 12 (paper 144, ResearchOutput/exp_net59_perlayer.py, /tmp/net59.log)

**Verdict name: NO-SINGLE-LAYER-IS-THE-BOTTLENECK.**

### Result
Solo-layer causal pruning profiles: for each of Qwen2.5-0.5B's 24 layers independently, oracle top-k applied ONLY to that layer (k=16 and k=32), all others full (ctx=512, 24 held-out windows):

- **k=16 profile: spread 0.6 points.** Best 1.0013 (L13), worst 0.9953 (L12); every layer ≥ 0.995.
- The identity tail: L21 0.9987, L22 0.9987, **L23 1.0008 — the BEST layer in the stack.**
- k=32: even flatter (spread 0.5 pts).

- **P1 TAIL-IS-CRITICAL REFUTED**: the tail is not individually fragile under top-k.
- **P2 CONFIRMED trivially**: all layers ≥ 0.995.
- **P3 NON-UNIFORM-MAP REFUTED**: the profile is remarkably uniform.

### The epistasis resolution
Four prior rounds established L22/L23 as categorically different: only far-from-tropical region (NET-50), highest crystallization loss, only cross-fine-tune decision divergence (NET-51), only unportable weights (NET-54), personal KV. Yet solo deletion costs ≈ 0. **The tail's role lives in interaction with upstream representations**, exactly as NET-54's swap-collapse showed directly. Additional structure: joint all-layer k=16 costs 1.7% (NET-50) vs ~4.8% if solo costs were additive — pruning interactions are SUB-ADDITIVE/redundant.

### Design implication
There is no per-layer budget hierarchy to exploit for mixed-precision serving at this scale; differentiation must come from interaction-aware or policy-level criteria.

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — three horns pre-stated incl. two refuted; (b) clean — causal solo profiles new in-programme; (c) confronted — limits: ONE context (512), solo-only granularity (pairs/joints open), 24 windows; (d) clean; (e) deterministic monotone profiles; (f) clean — gate exact, ALL_DONE_NET59; (g) fair — identical budgets per layer; (h) DIRECT.

Pairwise/joint tail ablations; 1.5B replication; probe+recency hybrid; domain-jump corpora; 7B cell.

## NET-56 — limited-memory axis, round 9 (paper 141, ResearchOutput/exp_net56_policy.py, /tmp/net56.log)

**Verdict name: THE-ORACLE-OVERSTATES-THE-DEPLOYABLE-WIN.**

### Result
Causally-honest streaming KV eviction (accumulated-score heavy-hitters, block-128, current block always cached, strict per-row causality) vs the omniscient oracle — same harness, same data, matched budgets (Qwen2.5-0.5B, ctx=1024):

| arm | B=32 | B=64 | B=128 |
|---|---|---|---|
| ORACLE (per-row top-k) | **0.9913 ✓** | **0.9953 ✓** | — |
| HH (accumulated, pure) | 0.8633 | 0.8822 | 0.9189 |
| HYB (HH + recency) | 0.9205 | 0.9384 | 0.9605 |

- **P1 CONFIRMED emphatically**: policy gap = 11.3 points at matched B=64 (not the ≥2% floor).
- **P2 CONFIRMED**: recency beats pure accumulation everywhere (+5.7/+5.6/+4.2 pts).
- **P3 REFUTED**: best-at-64 = 0.938 < 0.95; even a 12.5%-of-context cache tops out at 0.961.

Anchor: oracle arms cross-replicate NET-49's knee to four decimals (0.9913 vs 0.9912 at k=32).

### The law
The knee collapse (NET-49: knees {16,32,24}; NET-55: size-invariant) is real for an OMNISCIENT selector but does NOT transfer to online eviction: **trained attention is prunable in retrospect, not predictable in advance** — accumulated attention probability is a biased estimator of future importance. This is the measurable form of the catalogue's min-plus decoder-reliability barrier (no exponential reliability without assumptions). Deployment tables must be policy-adjusted; oracle quotes are upper bounds.

### Engineering record
Seven implementation variants were rejected by sanity gates before recording: two shape bugs; a stale kept-set that starved local context (retained 0.35–0.46); a per-block causal leak that let rows see their block's future (retained 2.06 > 1 — physically impossible); a strict-mask NaN; duplicate recency; and an unbound variable. The two invalid variants are retained in git history as bracketing negative controls. The recorded run passes retained∈(0,1), monotone budget response, and exact oracle replication.

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — three horns pre-stated incl. the refuted P3; (b) confronted — H2O/heavy-hitter literature exists; NEW = the quantified oracle-to-policy gap measured on the very harness that established the knees; (c) confronted — limits: ONE model, ONE context, block-128 granularity, no learned importance heads; (d) clean — held-out data, no training; (e) deterministic evals, sanity-band acceptance documented; (f) clean — ALL_DONE_NET56; (g) fair — identical harness/data for both arms, budgets matched exactly; (h) DIRECT.

### Next
Learned importance heads (can a tiny predictor close the gap?); per-layer budgets; 1.5B replication; corpus robustness (next cell).

Now 56 network experiments. Assessment v56. Paper 141.

## The unified framework

Every post-resume result fits into one framework:

> **The type-channel law.** For any polynomial f of degree n with Galois group G and abelianization G^ab, the complete splitting-type channel I(p mod |disc(f)|; T) equals H(T) − H(T|G^ab) — the label entropy minus the entropy of the cosets that the type cannot distinguish. | dial | s-carried | d-carried | s-d synergy | structure |

D₄ is sum-sufficient because its type map is f(p mod 8): (p+q) mod 8 determines p mod 8 and q mod 8 uniquely (q = N·p⁻¹ mod 8), hence determines the type pair. S₃ fields require both residues because the Legendre symbol (Δ|p) is not determined by (Δ|p)+(Δ|q).

## FACT round-31 #2 — INDEPENDENT-VERIFICATION (paper 109)

**Verdict name: THE-CHARACTER-CAPTURES-EXACTLY-ONE-BIT.**

### Result
Paper 80's key result **proven from character theory** without Monte Carlo:

For S₃ x³+x+1 (disc = −31, G = S₃, G^ab = C₂):
- Chebotarev densities: P('111') = 1/6, P('12') = 1/2, P('3') = 1/3 → H(T) = 1.4591 bits
- The sign character (−31|p) determines even/odd Frobenius
- H(type | sign) = (1/2)·H(1/3, 2/3) = 0.4591 (within-even-class split is residue-independent)
- **I(p mod 31; type) = H(T) − H(T|sign) = 1.0000 EXACTLY**

The character captures exactly one bit of type entropy. The remaining 0.4591 bits are locked behind the non-abelian structure, inaccessible from any residue.

### Mixed-type residues explained
The scan found 15 mixed-type residues — **expected and correct**: the sign character only separates even/odd Frobenius; within the even class, the split between identity and 3-cycles is residue-independent. The scan confirms the theory.

### Generalization
For ANY field with G^ab = C₂: I(p mod |disc|; type) = 1 bit exactly. This includes all S₃, S₄, and S₅ fields measured in papers 80–84.

Now 445 experiments. Assessment v220. Paper 109.

## FACT round-28 #4 — BATTERY-UTILITY (paper 98, /tmp/exp_batteryutility.py, /tmp/r28n4b.log)

**Verdict name: THE-LABELS-ARE-NOT-FILTERS.**

### Result
An honest refutation-by-design-flaw round closing the battery arc. The attempt to convert the 6-dial battery's 12.7-bit capacity into candidate-set narrowing for p required a map **residue r mod m\* → type of a prime ≡ r mod m\*** — and **that map does not exist**: primes in the same residue class carry different splitting types. This is precisely why every measured channel sits below its label-entropy ceiling (S₃a: I = 1.0012 vs H(T) = 2.2982 — the gap IS the within-class variation).

### What happened
The utility tables were built by polynomial evaluation at r (does f(r) ≡ 0 mod m\*?) — testing whether r itself is a root, not which type primes ≡ r carry. The consistency assert caught true-p exclusions (6/150 via a quartic enumeration precedence bug; the cubic unions passed 0/150 only by covering nearly all residues). The diagnosis elevated the bug to the finding.

### The corrected understanding
The battery's labels are statistics of the JOINT (p mod m\*, q mod m\*) draw, not functions of single residues. Utility must be stated Bayesianly: the label vector is a 12.7-bit posterior update on the joint residue vector (~20 bits) — exactly as the capacity law says. Converting that posterior into individual-candidate narrowing requires the per-prime type determination that IS the factoring problem. No-pinning consistency: constant-bounded posterior mass on joint residue vectors; no candidate filter without circularity.

## FACT round-28 #2 — THE-GAP-LOCAL-METHOD (paper 96, /tmp/exp_gaplocal.py, /tmp/r28n2d.log)

**Verdict name: THE-TAXONOMY-IS-COMPLETE.**

### Result
Fermat — the one classical method never locality-classified — measured: its iteration count is **exactly (p+q)/2 − √N** (identity 24/24 with per-draw instrumentation), and across balance ratios r = q/p ∈ [2, 64] at fixed p the cost interpolates **352 → 100 282 iterations** (in p-units 0.09 → 24.50; at r = 64 the measured cost is 0.78 of the cofactor-linear limit p·(r−1)/2). Fermat is **GAP-LOCAL**: neither factor-local like ρ/ECM nor a scan like trial division, but a function of the gap alone.

### The completed locality table
| method | locality class | cost |
|---|---|---|
| trial division | p-linear | p |
| Pollard ρ | factor-local | √p |
| ECM | factor-local | sub-exp in p |
| **Fermat** | **gap-local** | **(p+q)/2 − √N** |

Four methods, three locality classes — which methods see the factor (ρ, ECM), which see the gap (Fermat), and which see nothing but the scan (trial division).

### Bonus finding: the degenerate square case
The r = 1 grid row exposed that when q lands on p itself (N = p²), Fermat's target a = p lies **below** its starting point ⌊√N⌋ + 1 — plain Fermat has no true stopping point on prime squares and only exits by accidentally hitting an unrelated square (here after 8 372 232 iterations). CFRAC-style generalizations do not share the defect.

### Method ledger
(1) The first launch hung 7+ minutes in H1 — faulthandler stack dump found the root cause: **the fermat loop lacked its increment** (`a += 1` lost between drafts), spinning on a constant value; the standalone control with the increment ran instantly. (2) Stale assert constant (40 vs 24 draws) fixed.

Now 431 experiments. Assessment v207. Paper 96.

## FACT round-26 #3 — SUBEXP-STRATUM (paper 90, /tmp/exp_subexpstratum.py, /tmp/r26n3e.log)

**Verdict name: THE-STRATUM-STAYS-UNMEASURED — an honest inconclusive.**

### Result
The fourth stratum (sub-exponential sieves, L_{1/2}) **could not be measured at toy scale**. With x uniform in [√N, 2√N], per-sample u = log(x²−N)/log B, 2400 samples over six (N, B) cells, compared against numerically-integrated Dickman ρ:

| u | n | empirical | ±1σ | ρ(u) numeric | ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3.0 | 161 | 0.0124 | 0.0087 | 0.0487 | 0.26 |
| 3.5 | 265 | 0.0302 | 0.0105 | 0.0163 | 1.86 |
| 4.0 | 413 | 0.0073 | 0.0042 | 0.0049 | 1.47 |
| 5.0 | 303 | 0.0033 | 0.0033 | 0.00036 | 9.27 |

Ratios scatter non-monotonically (0.26–9.3); most bins underpowered at ±σ ≈ 100% relative; three bins sit where ρ predicts below MC reach. The toy cost model C(B) = π(B)/ρ(u) + π(B)² fits d(log₂C)/d(log₂N) = 0.024 — flat, cannot place the stratum.

### Two real findings inside the null
1. **The leading-term Dickman approximation is invalid at small u**: exp(−u(ln u + ln ln u − 1)) gives 0.561 at u = 3 where true ρ(3) = 0.0487 — **a 12× error**, persisting through u = 6. Proper numerical integration implemented (Euler 5×10⁻⁴ on uρ′(u) = −ρ(u−1)). Any informal smoothness argument using the leading-term form below u ≈ 8 is quantitatively meaningless.
2. **x²−N smoothness is not random-integer smoothness at toy scale**: even against correct ρ the ratios are non-monotone — consistent with the quadratic-character constraint on prime divisors of x²−N, whose O(1) corrections stabilize only asymptotically.

### Method ledger
(1) First design sampled x in a width-10³ window (x²−N ~ N^{1/2+}-scale) while computing u at N-scale — the entire first comparison mis-binned (caught by empirical-above-predicted anomalies). (2) A pre-written success VERDICT over contradicting data — replaced by data-computed output before claims. (3) Trailing-quote syntax break caught by ast.parse.

### What this decides
The landscape stands at **three measured strata plus one unmeasured**. Open targets now explicitly include: the formal barrier-4 converse proof, and a production-scale measurement of the sub-exponential stratum.

Now 425 experiments. Assessment v201. Paper 90.

## FACT round-25 #1 — QUBIT-TRADE2 (paper 85, /tmp/exp_qubittrade2.py, /tmp/r25n1g.log)

**Verdict name: ONE-REGISTER-BIT-IS-WORTH-ONE-SAMPLE.**

### Result
The qubit/sample phase diagram of Shor period-finding is a **fungibility ramp**, not a wall. The pre-stated vertical-wall hypothesis (odd r ⟹ deterministic certification failure below t = 2log₂r) was **honestly refuted** by the correct measurement kernel: under the standard arithmetic-progression distribution P(k) = (1/Mq)·|sin(πMkr/q)/sin(πkr/q)|² (M ≈ q/r), the per-sample certification rate follows **P₁ ≈ ramp(q/r²)**, and samples compound it as P_s = 1−(1−P₁)^s. The measured exchange law: **t\*(s) shifts by −log₂ s** — one register bit is worth one sample.

### The three measurements
1. **The single-sample ramp**: P₁ rises smoothly with q/r² through odd/mixed families (4·odd: 0.003 at q/r² = 0.028 → 0.36 at 0.905 → plateau ≈ 0.46); pure powers of two are flat-saturated (~0.5 at every ratio — peaks exactly on grid points).
2. **Sample ladders out-of-sample**: P_s tracks 1−(1−P₁)^s tightly everywhere (odd prime at wall−1: P₁ = 0.725 → s=2: 0.940 vs predicted 0.924; 2·odd at wall−3: P₁ = 0.055 → s=20: 0.680 vs predicted 0.677).
3. **The exchange law** (odd composite 1155, wall t = 21): t\*(P≥0.5) shifts {s=2: +0, s=5: −2, s=20: −4, s=100: −6} against −log₂s = {−1, −2.3, −4.3, −6.6}. (s=1 never crosses 0.5: the saturation level P₁ ≈ 0.37 *is* the standard per-sample rate.)

### The honest refutation
The stated-before-run mechanism (deterministic sub-wall failure for odd r) holds only for the WORST-case peak position; actual peak positions spread over [0, ½], so certification succeeds at rate ≈ q/r². Round-14's "10 samples fail" was the deep-ramp limit (q/r² ≈ 0). The refutation, not the confirmation, produced the round's law.

### Method ledger (3 designed-check catches across 6 runs)
1. **Wrong kernel**: contiguous-block Dirichlet instead of the progression kernel — flagged by its degenerate signature P(k=0) = 1 at q = r; the first vertical-wall table was an artifact of the wrong ensemble.
2. **Post-processing swamp**: lcm-of-candidates dies on spurious small-denominator certificates; replaced by the clean CERTIFICATION STATISTIC (∃ sample whose CF passes 1/(2b²) with b = r — necessary condition for any post-processing; classical period-verification free).
3. Degenerate regimes documented: pure powers of two at t = v₂(r) give uniform outcomes (entropy = log₂q, r-independent — genuinely no information).

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — pre-stated hypothesis refuted by pre-registered measurement; replacement law validated out-of-sample on ladders; (b) clean — no exchange-rate work in the Catalog (nearest: our own paper 47); (c) confronted — exact distributions (no shortcuts), five structured periods, 300-trial cells; (d) clean — fixed seeds; (e) the substance — closed-form predictions vs MC ±0.03, full defect ledger disclosed; (f) controlled — every anomaly traced to root cause before proceeding; (g) fair — ladders are out-of-sample validations; families distinguished; (h) relevance — Shor's register can be shortened by paying samples linearly (1 bit ↔ 1 sample) until both explode together: the quantum advantage is preserved but quantitatively graded, sharpening DEQUANT beyond paper 47's binary threshold (barriers 4/8).

## FACT round-24 #2 — BERGGREN-3ADIC (paper 81, /tmp/exp_berggren3adic.py, /tmp/r24n2.log)

**Verdict name: THE-TREE-POSITION-IS-ADICALLY-SEALED.**

### Result
The Berggren tree position of the N-node (the Fermat pair of a semiprime, paper 56's exact embedding) carries **NO N-visible residue structure beyond the trace**. The channel decomposes into (i) a deterministic 3-adic skeleton that *restates* N mod 3 exactly, and (ii) a metric layer — branch letters, depth, path composition — that is **blind at every 3-adic level 3^k, k ≤ 6**. The Catalog's 3-adic Cantor boundary (#855) has no N-computable projection beyond the trace-set content.

### The four horns (all stated before the run; all confirmed)
- **H1 SKELETON (deterministic lemma)**: squares mod 3 = {0,1} + m⊥n ⟹ N ≡ 1 ⟺ 3|n, N ≡ 2 ⟺ 3|m, N ≡ 0 ⟺ 3∤mn — agreement **40000/40000 = 100%**. And it RESTATES the trace: 3|n ⟺ q≡p mod 3 ⟺ N ≡ p² ≡ 1 mod 3, also **40000/40000** — zero information beyond N mod 3 (barrier 6).
- **H2 PARENT-INTERVAL LAW (new exact lemma)**: the Berggren parent is decided by the ratio alone — m/n ∈ (1,2) → T₁ = (n,2n−m); (2,3) → T₂ = (n,m−2n); (3,∞) → T₃ = (m−2n,n). Verified on all **40000/40000** descents terminating exactly at root (2,1), plus **86,634 spot-checked steps** with child-map reconstruction (B₁(m,n)=(2m−n,m), B₂=(2m+n,m), B₃=(m+2n,n)) exact on every step.
- **H3 METRIC BLINDNESS**: I(N mod 3^k; b_t) at the 300-shuffle permutation null for every letter depth t ≤ 10 and level k ≤ 6; same for depth dB and composition (c₁,c₂,c₃). **Worst z = +2.51 across ~150 tests** (k=1: I(N mod 3; b₁) = 0.00004 vs null 0.00004, z = +0.04).
- **H4 CONTROLS (live)**: trace lemma I(N mod 3; s mod 3) = **1.0000** exact (paper 50); I(ratio-band; b₁) = **1.4738 = H(b₁)** EXACTLY — the first branch letter is a deterministic function of the m/n band, whose recovery IS the factorization; corr(log dB, log gap) = −0.141 replicates paper 56's anti-correlation.

### Sample
40,000 random semiprimes (p,q uniform primes in [2¹⁶, 2²⁴)), Miller-Rabin (12 bases), capped descents (5000 steps): twin-prime nodes n=1 descend stepwise in m and are censored — **42/40402 = 0.10%**, reported. Runtime 154 s.

### Why this matters
- Paper 56's orthogonality is sharpened from coordinate-level to **adic strength**: coordinates orthogonal AND position sealed.
- Tree-adic dials join the closed residue-dial family (papers 54/70/72–74/77/79/80): no dial exceeds its trace-set content; the metric interior requires the factorization to read.

## NET→FACT round-24 #1 — NONABELIAN-TYPE-CHANNEL (paper 80, /tmp/exp_nonabelian_typechan.py, /tmp/r24n1h.log)

**Verdict name: THE-TYPE-CHANNEL-IS-THE-ABELIANIZATION.**

### Result
The complete splitting-type channel of a **non-abelian** field is **exactly its abelianization content**: at the prime level **I(p mod m\*; T) = I(T; coset) = H(T) − H(T|coset)** (m\* = conductor of the G^ab characters), and at the semiprime level the papers 78/79 pair law holds **verbatim** with the class-level type map. Verified on S₃ ×2, S₄, A₄, D₄ with abelian controls V₄/C₄ — **7/7 fields prime, 7/7 semiprime, every field on its pre-stated value.**

### The law table (prime level, ~23k primes/field)
| field | G | G^ab | H(T) | I₁ measured | law | dial | loss |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S₃a x³+x+1 | S₃ | C₂ | 1.4591 | **1.0000** | 1.0000 ✓ | 1.0000 | 0 |
| S₃b x³−x+1 | S₃ | C₂ | 1.4591 | **1.0000** | 1.0000 ✓ | 1.0000 | 0 |
| S₄ x⁴−x−1 | S₄ | C₂ | 2.0944 | **1.0100** | 1.0000 ✓ | 1.0000 | 0 |
| A₄ x⁴+8x+12 | A₄ | C₃ | 1.1887 | **0.9188** | 0.9183 ✓ | 1.5850 | 2/3 |
| D₄ x⁴−2 | D₄ | C₂×C₂ | 1.9056 | **1.6555** | 1.6556 ✓ | 2.0000 | 0.3444 |
| V₄ x⁴−2x²+9 [ab.] | V₄ | C₂×C₂ | 0.8113 | **0.8092** | 0.8113 ✓ | 2.0000 | 1.1887 |
| C₄ Φ₅ [control] | C₄ | C₄ | 1.5000 | **1.4989** | 1.5000 ✓ | 2.0000 | 0.5 |

S₄ carries 2.0944 bits of splitting entropy and leaks exactly 1 bit; A₄'s [3,1] type fills both non-trivial C₃-cosets (loss exactly 2/3); D₄'s [2,2] merges two cosets; V₄'s three involutions all give [2,2]. Within-coset flatness at permutation nulls (z ≤ 0); thickening honest at the 0.004-bit level; coprime flat.

### The REVERSAL
Paper 77 ordered the control pair by forks: V₄ 0.8113 > D₄ 0.2936. The type channels order it **the other way**: V₄ 0.8092 **<** D₄ 1.6555. The readout's coset-separation — not the group's abelianness — decides which channel is richer. Both orderings are exact instances of the same law.

### Semiprime (400k MC/field, unramified pools)
S₃a **1.0001**, S₃b **1.0001**, S₄ **1.0034** vs law 1.0000 — **the C₂ cap is a theorem about the abelianization, not the type count** (a 5-type S₄ field cannot exceed the quadratic 1 bit). A₄ **0.4729** vs 0.4739 (dial-pair 1.5850). D₄ **1.4325** vs 1.4302 — a non-abelian channel ABOVE 1 bit, as its 2-D abelianization predicts. V₄ **0.2902** = Is(4) (paper-79 2-state identity). C₄ **1.2461** vs 1.25 (paper 78). Which-factor walls 0.0000–0.0001; pinned-fork s-projections reproduce Is(2)/Is(3)/Is(4) (papers 74/75).

### Method notes
Quartic types via F_{p²}-root counting ((nr, nr₂) from x^(p²) mod f + gcd) — the cubic-resolvent shortcut is INVALID for binomial/special quartics (x⁴−2's axis pairing is D₄-fixed; V₄'s resolvent splits over ℚ). Sparse-modulus discipline: permutation-null thickening and 400k MC (30k would leave ~0.10-bit bias in S₄'s 282×15-cell table). Runtime 314 s, all asserts green.

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — law + full table stated before the run, measurement independent of the dial; (b) clean — no non-abelian type-channel work in the Catalog (698-pkg scan: nearest are the lab's own #723–#728) or literature; (c) confronted — real Galois groups, 23k-prime histograms < 2% from class sizes, 400k-draw MC; (d) clean — deterministic + fixed seeds; (e) the substance — finite-sample margins quantified (S₄ +0.0100; thickening at 0.004-bit level under nulls); (f) controlled — exact laws vs MC asserted to 0.02, both estimator traps caught and repaired; (g) fair — V₄/C₄ controls reproduce papers 77/78/79 through the identical pipeline; (h) closure — symmetric (which-factor 0.0000, barrier 2), residue dial (barrier 5), N-computable only behind the CRT split (barrier 6), Galois + Chebotarev 1922 + reciprocity (barrier 8).

### What closes
The **type-channel program is complete**: papers 70 (flatness), 71 (criterion), 72–74 (binary laws), 75–77 (group table), 78–79 (abelian types) are all projections of one statement — the complete symmetric residue channel of splitting statistics equals the type's mutual information with the abelianization coset. The conjecture: the tree's proven structure theory (descent to (3,4,5), silver-ratio growth, groupoid) makes the tree a new, provably analyzable laboratory for the congruent number problem — in particular the density of congruent numbers (conjecturally about one half in each admissible residue class, open, and equivalent in depth to the rank distribution of the elliptic curves y² = x³ − n²x) can be attacked through the statistical structure of the tree's area values.

The catalog has fully formalized the tree (groupoid, hyperbolic geometry, silver speed limit) but has never studied its area function — the direct bridge to congruent numbers. The conjecture: the Dirichlet series Σ_{triples in tree} c^{-s} (summed over the hypotenuse c of each node, or over the nodes at depth n with their growth) has an abscissa of convergence computable from the silver ratio, and the count of nodes with hypotenuse ≤ H satisfies an exact asymptotic law with an explicit exponent.

Define the tree zeta function and prove its abscissa of convergence is governed by the silver-ratio growth exponent. Prove an asymptotic law for the number of Berggren-generated triples with hypotenuse ≤ H (the catalog already has the Θ(H) count of Berggren-generated triples vs. H³ total — sharpen this to an exact asymptotic with the silver-ratio exponent). Relate the zeta function to the known spectral structure of the generators (eigenvalues 3±2√2).

**Why now**: The catalog has exact metric growth (silver speed limit), exact counting (Θ(H) Berggren-generated triples), and spectral classification — but no analytic-number-theory object tying them together. A tree zeta function would unify the growth, counting, and spectral results into a single analytic object, connecting to the theory of zeta functions of graphs, trees, and dynamical systems.

**If true**: The Berggren tree acquires a zeta function with a silver-ratio abscissa of convergence, unifying its growth, counting, and spectral structure — a clean analytic-number-theory companion to the existing geometric and algebraic results, with connections to Ihara zeta functions and the zeta functions of trees.

**If false**: The Dirichlet series fails to have a meromorphic continuation or its abscissa is not the silver ratio, which is itself a sharp statement about the analytic structure of the tree's counting function.
title: Injected Direction: The Berggren Tree Zeta Function — Analytic Counting of Pythagorean Triples Governed by the Silver Ratio

**Domain**: Pythagorean <-> Geometry

For each n ≥ 3 there is a higher-dimensional "Pythagorean tree" generated by a finite set of Lorentz-preserving integer matrices acting on the null cone of the (n+1)-dimensional Lorentz form, generalizing the three Berggren moves. The conjecture: for n = 3 (Pythagorean quadruples / hyperspheres) there is a finite generating set of integer matrices, the tree has a well-defined hyperbolic embedding in the (n+1)-dimensional Poincaré ball, and its metric growth exponent is an exactly computable algebraic number generalizing the silver ratio log(1+√2).

**Test**: Formalize the null cone of the (n+1)-dimensional Lorentz form and the group of its integral Lorentz-preserving automorphisms. For n = 3, exhibit a finite generating set of matrices producing a tree of primitive Pythagorean quadruples, prove the tree's branching structure (how many children per node), and compute the hyperbolic metric growth exponent. Generalize the Berggren groupoid, the star-line structure, and the totient law to the higher-dimensional setting.

**Why now**: The entire existing corpus is the 2-dimensional Berggren tree. Higher-dimensional Pythagorean trees (quadruples, quintuples, hyperspheres) are a natural, essentially unexplored generalization that would extend the groupoid, hyperbolic-geometry, and growth machinery to a whole family of objects — and hypersphere packing / kissing-number questions give it concrete applications.

**If true**: A full higher-dimensional theory of Pythagorean trees emerges — groupoid, hyperbolic embedding, silver-ratio-type growth — generalizing the Berggren tree and connecting to sphere packing, quadratic forms in higher dimensions, and the arithmetic of the higher Lorentz groups.

**If false**: The higher-dimensional tree fails to be a clean ternary tree (e.g., branching grows with n, or the growth exponent is not algebraic), which itself characterizes how the beautiful 2-dimensional structure fails to generalize.
title: Injected Direction: Higher-Dimensional Pythagorean Trees — Generalizing the Berggren Tree to Pythagorean Quadruples and Hyperspheres

**Domain**: Pythagorean <-> Probability

**Hypothesis**: The boundary of the Berggren ternary tree of primitive Pythagorean triples is a 3-adic Cantor set, and a random walk on the tree (choosing among the three Berggren moves with probabilities p₁,p₂,p₃) converges to a harmonic measure on this boundary whose dimension and entropy are exactly computable. The conjecture: the harmonic measure of the random walk is a Bernoulli measure on the 3-adic boundary with entropy equal to the Shannon entropy H(p₁,p₂,p₃), and the spectral gap of the walk (the second eigenvalue of the associated Markov operator on the tree) is governed by the silver ratio log(1+√2) structure of the tree's growth.

**Test**: Formalize the boundary of the Berggren tree as the set of infinite words over the 3-letter alphabet {A,B,C}, i.e., the 3-adic Cantor set. Define the random walk with transition probabilities (p₁,p₂,p₃). Prove the harmonic measure is the product Bernoulli measure, compute its entropy and Hausdorff dimension, and compute the spectral gap of the Markov operator. Relate the return probabilities to the silver-ratio growth exponent already proven for the tree.

**Why now**: The catalog has exact metric growth (silver speed limit), the groupoid structure, and the hyperbolic embedding — but no probabilistic/ergodic theory. Random walks on the Berggren tree are a natural, untouched probabilistic counterpart to the deterministic geometry, connecting to the theory of random walks on hyperbolic groups, harmonic measure, and the geometry of Cantor-set boundaries.

**If true**: The Berggren tree becomes a fully understood example in the theory of random walks on hyperbolic trees — with exact harmonic measure, entropy, and spectral gap — a clean probabilistic companion to its deterministic geometry, with connections to the theory of free groups and their boundaries.

**If false**: The harmonic measure fails to be Bernoulli (e.g., the boundary carries a non-product measure), which would reveal hidden structure in how the three moves distribute mass, itself a novel statement.
title: Injected Direction: Harmonic Measure on the Berggren Tree Boundary — Random Walks and the 3-adic Cantor Set

**Domain**: Pythagorean <-> NumberTheory

**Hypothesis**: The Berggren moves, acting on ℤ³ and preserving the Lorentz form a²+b²−c², define a rich p-adic dynamical system. Reducing the moves modulo p^k turns the infinite ternary tree into a finite p-adic dynamical system whose orbit structure, periodic points, and mixing behavior are governed by the spectral properties of the three generators (two unipotent, one hyperbolic with eigenvalues 3±2√2). The conjecture: the hyperbolic Berggren generator acts on the p-adic null cone with a computable orbit structure that is periodic for all p, with period dividing p²−1 (matching the known modular order), and the two unipotent generators act nilpotently, producing a p-adic fractal attractor on the boundary of the tree.

**Test**: Formalize the action of the three Berggren matrices on (ℤ/p^k)³. Prove the spectral classification carries over p-adically (unipotent vs. hyperbolic). Compute the exact orbit structure of the hyperbolic generator on the p-adic null cone: period, number of orbits, and the p-adic distance contraction. Establish whether the tree, viewed p-adically, has a well-defined boundary (a p-adic Cantor set) and characterize its Hausdorff dimension.

**Why now**: The existing catalog has fully formalized the real/hyperbolic geometry of the Berggren tree and the modular spectral classification of its generators. The p-adic side is essentially untouched — only one low-priority direction mentions the moves mod m. p-adic dynamics of Lorentz-preserving ternary trees connects to p-adic ergodic theory, p-adic hyperbolic geometry, and the theory of p-adic lattices, and is a genuinely fresh frontier.

**If true**: The Berggren tree acquires a p-adic structure theory mirroring its real one, opening connections to p-adic arithmetic dynamics, p-adic Fuchsian groups, and possibly to local-global questions about which triples appear at which p-adic depths.

**If false**: The p-adic orbit structure collapses to something trivial (e.g., all moves contract to a single fixed point), which is itself a clean statement about why the p-adic and real geometries of the tree differ.
title: Injected Direction: p-adic Berggren Dynamics — The Tree of Pythagorean Triples as a p-adic Dynamical System

**Domain**: Pythagorean <-> Algebra

**Hypothesis**: The Berggren ternary tree of primitive Pythagorean triples and the Markoff tree are isomorphic as Lorentz-preserving ternary trees. The Berggren moves generate a groupoid acting on the null cone of the Lorentz form a²+b²−c²; the Markoff tree is generated by Vieta involutions preserving the Markoff form x²+y²+z²−3xyz. Both are ternary, both embed in hyperbolic space, and both have a "silver-ratio" growth spine (Berggren) / a golden-ratio spine (Markoff). The conjecture: there is a birational (or integer) transfer map carrying the Berggren tree's proven machinery — the groupoid structure, the hyperbolic embedding, the silver-ratio metric growth, the totient law for star arms — onto the Markoff tree.

**Test**: Formalize the Markoff tree as a ternary tree of integer triples under Vieta involutions. Construct the explicit transfer map from Berggren triples to Markoff triples (via the known parametrization of Markoff triples by Christoffel words / the Stern-Brocot tree, which is itself the Berggren tree in disguise). Prove the map is a tree isomorphism preserving the ternary branching, and transfer at least one structural theorem (e.g., the uniqueness of the growth spine, or the groupoid action) from the Berggren side to the Markoff side.

**Why now**: The Markoff uniqueness conjecture (that every Markoff triple is uniquely determined by its largest element) is a famous open problem. The Berggren tree already carries a fully formalized groupoid, hyperbolic geometry, and exact growth theory in this catalog. A transfer theorem would be a genuinely new bridge from a solved structure to an open one — the highest-value possible outcome.

**If true**: The Berggren tree's machinery becomes a tool for the Markoff tree, opening a new attack line on Markoff uniqueness and the geometric structure of Markoff triples (which connect to the modular group, continued fractions, and the theory of quadratic forms).

**If false**: The failure point (where the transfer breaks — e.g., the Lorentz form vs. Markoff form are not conjugate over ℤ) is itself a theorem about why the two trees differ, clarifying the boundary between them.
title: Injected Direction: Markoff Tree Transfer — Carrying the Berggren Tree's Machinery to the Markoff Tree

body: It is a direct adaptation of the standard Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) objective with a pre-training mix-in (PTX)—originally introduced in the InstructGPT / PPO alignment framework (Ouyang et al., 2022)—rebranded with neurosymbolic notation.Breakdown of the Components$$\text{Objective}(\phi) = \underbrace{\mathbb{E}_{x, y}\left[ RM_{NS}(x, y) \right]}_{\text{1. Reward Maximization}} - \underbrace{\beta_{NS} \mathbb{E}_{x, y}\left[ \log \frac{LLM_\phi^{NS}(y\vert{}x)}{LLM^{SFT}(y\vert{}x)} \right]}_{\text{2. KL-Divergence Penalty}} + \underbrace{\gamma_{NS} \mathbb{E}_{x}\left[ \log LLM_\phi^{NS}(x) \right]}_{\text{3. Pretraining Loss Mix-in (PTX)}}$$NeuroSymbolic Reward Term:$\mathbb{E}_{x \sim \mathcal{D}_{RL}, y \sim LLM_\phi^{NS}(x)} [RM_{NS}(x, y)]$Optimizes the policy parameters ($\phi$) to generate outputs $y$ given prompts $x$ that maximize the score from a (neurosymbolic) reward model $RM_{NS}$.KL Penalty (Regularization):$-\beta_{NS} \log \frac{LLM_\phi^{NS}(y\vert{}x)}{LLM^{SFT}(y\vert{}x)}$The point-wise Kullback–Leibler ($\text{D}_{\text{KL}}$) divergence penalty. It prevents the tuned policy $LLM_\phi^{NS}$ from drifting too far from the base Supervised Fine-Tuned model ($LLM^{SFT}$), preventing policy collapse and reward hacking. $\beta_{NS}$ controls the penalty strength.Pretraining Mix-in Gradient ($\text{PPO-ptx}$ term):$+\gamma_{NS} \mathbb{E}_{x \sim \mathcal{D}_{pretrain}} \log LLM_\phi^{NS}(x)$Maximizes the log-likelihood over the original pretraining distribution $\mathcal{D}_{pretrain}$ with coefficient $\gamma_{NS}$. This standard trick avoids performance regression on general NLP benchmarks during RL fine-tuning.TakeawayMathematical Validity: 100% sound; it directly mirrors the standard InstructGPT alignment equation.Practical Meaning: It represents fine-tuning a model using RLHF, where the reward signal ($RM_{NS}$) or the model architecture incorporates neurosymbolic rules/logic rather than purely human-labeled reward modeling.
title: reinforcement learning

## NET-48 — speed axis (round-net-48; paper 92, /tmp/exp_net_attncost_ctx2048_s3.py, /tmp/net48.log)

**Verdict name: THE-DIRECT-TEST-SURVIVES-VIA-THE-MEDIAN.**

### Result
At (d=4, ctx=2048, seed=3), **k\* = 160 — all four point-horns REFUTED (P1 224, P2 240, P3 256, P4 192: every pre-stated value passes, none is the knee)**, yet the completed 16× three-seed knee distribution **{160, 224, 256} has median EXACTLY 224 = 7/8·(d·ctx/32)**, replicating the 8× median 112 = 7/8·128: **the 7/8-median law is 2/2-context, 6/6-seed.** The horns were point-predictions; the law's claim was the distribution's center — 0/4 horns, 1/1 law. A whole family of third-seed values {160, 192, 224} each keep the median at 224; only ≥256 would shift it.

### The 7/8-median law now two contexts, six seeds
| context | three-seed k\* set | × product | spread | median |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8× (ctx=1024) | {96, 112, 128} | {0.75, 0.875, 1.0} | 0.25 | 112 = 7/8·128 |
| 16× (ctx=2048) | {160, 224, 256} | {0.625, 0.875, 1.0} | 0.375 | 224 = 7/8·256 |

**The 16× spread is ~50% WIDER than the 8× spread** — the LOW TAIL is the context-growing quantity (0.75 → 0.625), the product value the pinned upper edge (the s1 chain's exactness), the median stable at 7/8. Per-seed knees are too noisy to predict on the point; the distribution's center is the robust quantity — that is what a third seed buys.

### Key numbers
- Full acc 0.1546, bar 0.1516, full loss 5.2199, train **14566s (~4h03m)**.
- Sweep: 96 0.963 ✗, 128 0.973 ✗, **160 0.981 ✓ (margin +0.0012 — the tightest of the recent cells; true knee ~150–160 between grid points)**, 192 0.984 ✓, 224 0.986 ✓, 240 0.987 ✓, **256 0.990 ✓ (product point — passes 3/3)**, 288 0.993 ✓, 384 0.999 ✓, 512 1.000 ✓, 768 1.003 ✓, 1024 1.003 ✓ (loss 5.2215, Δ0.0016). The s3 retained curve is the HIGHEST of the three 16× seeds throughout (0.973 at 128 vs s1 0.939, s2 0.965) — crossing the bar two grid steps earlier than s2, three than s1.
- **Product-law upper bound 3/3-sure at BOTH long contexts**: product point 256 passes 0.981/0.986/0.990 (joining 8×'s 0.986/0.993/0.988 at 128) — k\* ≤ d·ctx/32 is a six-seed-verified deployment guarantee through 16×.
- **Selection importance +4.7/+3.4**: k=128 random 0.926 vs top-k 0.973; k=256 0.956 vs 0.990 — comparable to s2, far above s1's +1.7/+1.8; the 16× selection spread {1.7, 4.4, 4.7} at k=128 is three-fold (dilution strongly seed-dependent).
- **Concentration**: eff support 498.13 (s1 526.39, s2 472.50 — mid-family, spread ~11%); top-128 0.608, top-256 0.746; per-position 64.91/435.27/929.55 — the eff↔knee correlation again does NOT sort across three points (s1 highest-eff/highest-knee, s2 lowest-eff/middle-knee, s3 middle-eff/lowest-knee), NO bounded working set at 16×, three seeds.
- **Deployable at (d=4, ctx=2048)**: **≥8.0× guaranteed (3/3), 9.1× median, 12.8× best — the BEST-EVER reading** (beats 10.7× at 8× s2). Distribution {8.0, 9.1, 12.8} wider than 8×'s {8.0, 9.1, 10.7}.

### The 16× three-seed table
| seed | k\* | × product (256) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (NET-45) | 256 | 1.000 |
| 2 (NET-46) | 224 | 0.875 |
| **3 (this round)** | **160** | **0.625** |

### All 8 barriers
(a) clean — four horns + the law's direct test stated before the run, measured 160 outside ALL horns, yet the distribution's median landed exactly on the law's predicted center (the round separates point-accuracy 0/4 from structural confirmation 1/1); (b) clean — three-seed 16× spread / widening low tail / median-stable center: none in the Catalog (698-pkg) or literature; (c) confronted — d=4 × ctx=2048 real causal word LM, 4097 vocab, held-out loss+acc, three seeds at the longest cell; (d) clean — held-out last-10%, data-free top-k; (e) the SUBSTANCE, sharpened — the 16× three-seed distribution complete; honest limits: the s3=160 read razor-thin (+0.0012), the 0.625 low tail is ONE of three seeds (a fourth decides s3-specific vs stable), the median law is 2 contexts × 3 seeds; (f) clean — same metrics/protocol, binom SE ≈ 0.11% acc (retained SE ≈ 0.007), the razor margin documented, k=512 recovers 1.000 / k=768 1.003 (loss Δ0.0016), monotone recovery, NO crash (ALL_DONE_NET48); (g) fair — full-attention reference + same 0.98 bar + random-k at same k (seed 12345): gaps +4.7/+3.4, positive, the {1.7–4.7} seed spread informative; (h) sharpened — the widened {8.0–12.8} deployment spread is the deployment-relevant uncertainty at the longest cell, guarantee end 3/3-sure.

### Next
**A fourth seed at ctx=2048** (the LOW-TAIL test — s4=160/192 → the 0.625 low tail is real, a stable 16× feature; s4 in {224,256} → it was s3-specific; ~4–5h — the highest-value open cell now); a fourth seed at ctx=1024 (refine {96,112,128}; low value); d=8 @ ctx=256 s0 corner; d=8 compression floor check; carry chain at scale (the frontier).

Now 48 network experiments. Assessment v48. Paper 92.

## NET-42 — Round 42 of the network/LLM lab (speed axis): DEPTH-LEG-AT-LONG-CONTEXT-IS-CONCAVE-POWER

**Question (the discriminating rung):** NET-40/41 measured the d=16 ctx=512 knee at 160 (s1) and 144 (s2) — seed-fluctuating in (144, 160], exactly bracketing the affine-law prediction (8d+32 = 160) and a concave power-law continuation (k* ≈ 28.3·d^0.585 ≈ 144). The exact functional form at the deepest rung was UNDECIDED at two seeds. This round measures d=32 at ctx=512 — the one cell where the two candidate forms separate by ~34% (far beyond the ±1-grid-step knee fuzz), so a SINGLE seed discriminates robustly.

**Prediction stated BEFORE the run:** k* = 288 if affine; ≈224 if concave power; 512 if the product form d·ctx/32 recovers at depth.

**Setup:** Byte-identical harness to NET-40/41 — CausalTF dm=64, 4 heads, d=32, seed=1, ctx=512, 5 Gutenberg novels (vocab 4097), contiguous 90/10 split, 2000 AdamW steps, 11113s train. Full acc 0.1353, bar 0.1326, loss 5.6281.

**Result — k\* = 256, NEITHER horn:**

| k | retained | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 96 | 0.916 | ✗ |
| 128 | 0.948 | ✗ |
| 160 | 0.964 | ✗ (d=16's two-seed knee region fails ~1.5 SE at d=32 — depth right-shift continues) |
| 192 | 0.975 | ✗ |
| 224 | 0.977 | ✗ knife-edge — fail by 0.003 ≈ 0.3 SE |
| **256** | **0.987** | ✓ **k\* = 256** |
| 288 (8d+32) | 0.989 | ✓ affine passes but is NOT minimal — over-predicts by 11% |
| 320 | 0.993 | ✓ |
| 384 | 0.995 | ✓ |
| 512 (d·ctx/32) | 1.000 | ✓ product passes (loss 5.6281 = full exactly) but is refuted by 2× |

**The four-rung shape settles the form — k\* ≈ 24.7·d^(2/3):**

| d | k* (ctx=512) | affine 8d+32 | power 24.7·d^(2/3) | product d·ctx/32 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 64 | 64 | 62 | 64 |
| 8 | 96 | 96 | 99 | 128 |
| 16 | 160/144 | 160 | 157 | 256 |
| 32 | **256** | **288** | **249** | 512 |

A log-log regression over the four ctx=512 rungs fits all four to ≤3% (62/99/157/249); the exponent is ROBUST to which d=16 seed anchors it (0.666 with s2's 144, 0.673 with s1's 160 — both ≈ 2/3). **The affine law 8d+32 — exact at d=4/8/16-s1 — was a 3-point LOCAL LINEAR approximation of this concave power curve and breaks at d=32.** NET-40/41's naive power fit (28.3·d^0.585) was biased by anchoring on a single noisy s2 d=16 reading. So NET-40/41's indecision RESOLVES cleanly: affine was the local form, the GLOBAL form is concave power ≈ 2/3.

**Sub-linear depth leg continues at every rung:** per-doubling ratio 1.50 → 1.58 → 1.68, approaching but never reaching 2.0 through d=32 — the product law does NOT recover at depth (256 = exactly half of 512).

**Practical:** deployable speedup at ctx=512: d=4 → 8.0×, d=8 → 5.33×, d=16 → 3.2–3.56×, d=32 → **2.0×** (guarantee 4×/4×/2×/**1×** — the product law gives NO speedup at d=32; the actual knee gives 2.0×, the largest over-pruneable factor yet).

**Concentration:** eff support **218.46** (depth diffusion continues; 199.84 → 218.46, ×1.09 on the doubling — the rate saturates while the diffusion continues); top-256 mass 0.921 (below d=16's 0.934/0.935 — at d=32 even the knee-k captures only 92% of the attention mass); per-position 27.81/190.90/409.08 — NO bounded working set.

**Honest limits (documented):**
- **Barrier (e):** the d=32 cell is SINGLE-SEED (every new rung starts single-seed), but the knee is bracketed (k=224 fails 0.3 SE, k=256 passes 0.7 SE) and the exponent-2/3 fit rests on FOUR rungs robust to the d=16 seed — the affine-vs-power discrimination at d=32 is a ~34% separation, far beyond the knee fuzz.
- **Barrier (f) — HONEST CRASH LOG:** the k=768 sweep point threw `RuntimeError: selected index k out of range` (topk(768) on a 512-wide causal attention row — my sweep-design bug; 768 is only valid at ctx ≥ 768), killing the run before Part B2 and the KSTAR/ALL_DONE prints. The point was REDUNDANT (k=512 already = 1.000, exact full loss), so the k\* verdict is UNAFFECTED.
- **Barrier (g):** the random-k control at (d=32, ctx=512) is UNMEASURED due to the crash (standing evidence: selection gap positive in every prior cell, +2.3 to +11.7).

**Verdict:** DEPTH-LEG-AT-LONG-CONTEXT-IS-CONCAVE-POWER — k\* ≈ 24.7·d^(2/3) at ctx=512, with k\* = 256 at (d=32, ctx=512) refuting BOTH the affine prediction (288, over by 11%) and the naive concave-power prediction (≈215, under by ~16%); the product law (512) refuted by 2×. The affine law was a 3-point local linearization that breaks at d=32; the concave-power-with-2/3 is the global form. Deployable speedup at (d=32, ctx=512) = 2.0× vs the 1.0× guarantee.

**Next (highest value):** **d=32 ctx=512 second seed** — closes the deepest rung's single-seed status AND repairs the missing random-k control (the script must drop k=768 / clamp to min(k, L)); then ctx=1024 second seed; d=8 @ ctx=256 s0 corner; carry chain at scale (the frontier).

## NET-40 — DEPTH-LEG-IS-AFFINE-AT-LONG-CONTEXT (round-net-40, speed axis, paper 84)

**Program:** Network/LLM research lab. Machine-verified (data-free top-k key/value pruning on a real causal word LM, d=16, seed=1, ctx=512, 5 Gutenberg novels, dm=64, vocab 4097, 2000 AdamW steps, 6472s training).

### Hypothesis
NET-38/39 measured k*=96 at (d=8, ctx=512) at TWO seeds — read as a sub-linear depth leg: ×1.5 on doubling d at ctx=512 (64→96) vs ×2.0 exact at ctx=128. The next rung (d=16) discriminates. Three horns, prediction stated BEFORE the run:
- **P1** k* ≈ 144 = ×1.5·96 → the ×1.5 sub-linear coefficient CONTINUES at the same rate
- **P2** k* = 256 = d·ctx/32 → the law RECOVERS at depth
- **P3** k* ≈ 128–160 (other) → a non-trivial intermediate law

### Result — k* = 160, NEITHER horn (P3 outcome)
Sweep {32,64,96,128,144,160,192,224,256,384} (enriched in [96,256]; k=16 dropped as a foregone failure). k* = smallest k with retained ≥ 0.98·full.

| k | retained | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 32 | 0.854 | ✗ |
| 64 (**4d**) | 0.917 | ✗ depth-only far short at depth |
| 96 | 0.944 | ✗ d=8's knee fails ~4 SE at d=16 — depth right-shift confirmed |
| 128 | 0.967 | ✗ |
| 144 (**×1.5·96**) | 0.976 | ✗ **P1 REFUTED — 2.7 SE below bar** |
| **160** | **0.981** | ✓ **k\*=160** |
| 192 | 0.991 | ✓ |
| 224 | 0.993 | ✓ |
| 256 (**d·ctx/32**) | 0.993 | ✓ P2 passes but is NOT minimal (37.5% above) |
| 384 | 1.000 | ✓ loss 5.3172 ≈ full 5.3147 |

### The depth leg at ctx=512 is AFFINE: k* = 8d + 32
| d | k* (seeds) | d·ctx/32 | **8d + 32** | ratio on doubling d |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 64, 64 (NET-35/36) | 64 | **64** | — |
| 8 | 96, 96 (NET-38/39) | 128 | **96** | ×1.5 |
| 16 | **160** (this round) | 256 | **160** | ×1.67 |

All three ctx=512 points lie EXACTLY on **k\* = 8d + 32 = (ctx/64)·d + (ctx/16)** — slope HALF the small-context value (ctx/32=16 → ctx/64=8) plus a positive intercept (ctx/16=32). The depth ratio ×1.67 (not ×1.5) refutes the power-law reading of NET-38/39's ×1.5 — it was the FIRST STEP of the affine law (ratios approach ×2 as d grows, as the intercept's relative share shrinks). At ctx ≤ 256 the law is EXACT product (d=8 ctx=256: k*=64, not 96), so the product→affine crossover lies in (256, 512].

### Conclusions
- **The guarantee d·ctx/32 is a proven-safe upper bound at long context**; actual available speedup at ctx=512: d=4 → **8.0×**, d=8 → **5.33×**, d=16 → **3.2×** (guarantee 4×/4×/2×) — over-pruneable by up to 1.6×, growing with depth.
- Concentration depth-diffuses: eff support **199.84** (152.11 → 177.80 → 199.84 across d=4/8/16 at ctx=512); top-128 mass DROPS to 0.771 (vs 0.806/0.814); per-position 25.55/174.57/372.99 — NO bounded working set.
- Selection importance DILUTES with depth: random-k gaps +3.4/+2.3 — the smallest of any cell (+3.7–10 elsewhere).

### Barriers
(a) no circularity — prediction stated before the run; outcome (160) is neither horn, so it discriminates and reveals a third structure; (b) no known-method-in-disguise — no depth-scaling law for data-free attention pruning in Catalog re-scan or the literature (nearest: layer-pruning arXiv 2512.20636, KV-cache pruning — orthogonal); (c) toy-scale confronted — d=16 × ctx=512 real causal word LM; (d) no data leakage (held-out last-10%, data-free top-k); (e) the round's honest limit — d=16 SINGLE-SEED, SOFTEST knee of the series (k=144 fails 2.7 SE, k=160 passes 0.7 SE; crossing robustly in (144, 160]), mitigated by the three-depth SHAPE (d=4/d=8 two-seed, all three exactly on 8d+32); (f) measurement documented (k=384 converges, binom SE ≈0.15%); (g) no baseline unfairness (full-attention reference, random-k control, same bar); (h) sharpened — the depth leg's true form at long context is now measured, not guessed.

### Verdict
**DEPTH-LEG-IS-AFFINE-AT-LONG-CONTEXT** — k\* = 160 at (d=16, ctx=512), completing the exact three-point linear law k\* = 8d + 32 = (ctx/64)·d + (ctx/16) at ctx=512. The ×1.5 sub-linear coefficient of NET-38/39 is NOT a power law (P1 refuted, second doubling ×1.67) and the law does NOT recover to d·ctx/32 (P2 non-minimal). Honest limit: d=16 cell single-seed — a second seed is the immediate next round (mirroring NET-38→39). Remaining: **d=16 ctx=512 second seed (the affine law's third rung — highest value)**, ctx=1024 second seed, d=8 @ ctx=256 s0 corner.

| 16 | 0.915 | 0.904 | ✗ |
| 32 (**4d**) | 0.952 | 0.938 | ✗ depth-only refuted even more decisively |
| 64 (**ctx/8**) | 0.979 (marginal) | **0.973** | ✗ context-only refuted CLEANLY — 4.5 SE below bar |
| **96** | 0.990 | **0.987** | ✓ **k\*=96 at both seeds** |
| 128 (**d·ctx/32**) | 0.995 | 0.992 | ✓ safe but NOT minimal |
| 192 | 0.995 | 0.999 | ✓ |
| 256 | 0.999 | 1.001 (re-norm MC sat.) | ✓ |
| 384 | 0.998 (loss ≈ full) | 1.000 (loss 5.1504 ≈ full 5.1499) | ✓ |

**The sub-linear depth leg is a two-seed property at both depths:**
| (d, ctx) | k* (two seeds) | d·ctx/32 | depth ratio on doubling d |
|---|---|---|---|
| d=4, ctx=512 | 64, 64 (NET-35/36) | 64 | — |
| **d=8, ctx=512** | **96, 96** (NET-38/39) | 128 | **×1.5, ×1.5** |
| d=4, ctx=128 | 16, 16 | 16 | — |
| d=8, ctx=128 | 32, 32 | 32 | ×2.0, ×2.0 (exact) |
| d=16, ctx=128 | 64, 64 | 64 | ×2.0, ×2.0 (exact) |

At ctx=128 the depth leg is exactly linear (k*=4d, all depths, two seeds). At ctx=512 it is sub-linear (×1.5 at both seeds) — the retrieval load is shared across the deeper stack at long context.

### Conclusions
- **d·ctx/32 is a PROVEN-SAFE UPPER BOUND at long context** — the actual knee is systematically below it. Deployable speedup at (d=8, ctx=512) is **5.33×, not 4×**, at both seeds.
- NET-38's honest limit RESOLVED: the soft-knee concern is gone (s2's k=64 fails cleanly by 4.5 SE — the crossing is genuinely in (64, 96], not a bar-straddle).
- Concentration reproducible to ~2.5% (eff support 173.23 vs s1 177.80); diffusion continues (per-position 22.33/151.63/326.05 — NO bounded working set).
- Selection importance survives: random-k gaps +5.3/+5.0 (vs s1 +6.4/+3.7).

### Barriers
(a) no circularity — prediction stated before the run; (b) no known-method-in-disguise — Catalog re-scan (698 pkgs) found no sub-linear-depth/cross-layer-redundancy result; (c) toy-scale confronted — d=8 × ctx=512 real causal word LM; (d) no data leakage — held-out last-10% windows; (e) variance — the round's content, clean (k* 96=96; k=64 fail 4.5 SE); (f) measurement documented (k=256 1.001 = re-norm MC saturation; binom SE ≈0.15%); (g) no baseline unfairness (full-attention reference, random-k control, same 0.98 bar); (h) practical relevance strengthened (prune MORE than the guarantee, systematically).

### Verdict
**SUB-LINEAR-DEPTH-LEG-CONFIRMED-AT-A-SECOND-SEED** — k* = 96 = 96 at (d=8, ctx=512, seeds 1 and 2), exactly reproducing NET-38's measurement (P1). The ×1.5 depth coefficient at ctx=512 is a systematic two-seed property; the law's linear form is a safe upper bound at long context. Honest limits: ctx=512 at d=16 UNMEASURED (the natural next discriminating test — does the sub-linearity continue? predicts k*≈144 = ×1.5·96 if it does, vs 256 = d·ctx/32 if the law recovers); ctx=1024 remains single-seed.

body:
**Program:** Network/LLM research lab — round-net-38 (speed-axis round 11). Paper 82.

## Hypothesis

The attention-cost law **k\* = d·ctx/32** (data-free top-k key/value pruning, per-query/per-head by trained weight at inference, renormalized; k\* = smallest k with retained ≥ 0.98·full) holds at every measured grid cell (NET-15/16/17/20/33/34/35/36/37), but never at a cell where the three candidate rules ALL disagree. At **(d=8, ctx=512)** the depth leg (4d) predicts **32**, the context leg at d=4 (ctx/8) predicts **64**, and the unified product law predicts **128** — three values separated by 2× each. A single measurement discriminates the *multiplicative* form (depth and context act together) from a *single-lever dominant* rule.

- **P1** k\* = 128 (d·ctx/32) → product form holds at the discriminating corner.
- **P2** k\* = 32 (4d) or 64 (ctx/8) → single-lever rule dominates; multiplicative form breaks here.
- **P3** k\* = 128 but thin margin / shifted concentration → report both.

## Setup (byte-identical harness)

CausalTF d=8, seed=1, ctx=512 (dm=64, 4 heads, 5 Gutenberg novels, vocab 4097, contiguous 90/10 split, 2000 AdamW steps, 3889s train; 1171 windows, 10% held out). Eval via explicit causal-attention forward; top-k mask from each eval input's own trained attention; random-k control (rng seed 12345). Sweep {16,32,64,96,128,192,256,384} — the 96 point added inside the 2× grid to resolve the region between the ctx/8 and product knees. Script /tmp/exp_net_attncost_d8_ctx512.py, log /tmp/net38.log.

## Result

**k\* = 96 — NONE of the three predictions.** Full acc 0.1568 (bar 0.1536), loss 5.1355.

| k | retained | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 0.915 | ✗ |
| 32 (**4d**) | 0.952 | ✗ depth-only rule REFUTED (18 SE below bar) |
| 64 (**ctx/8**) | **0.979** | ✗ context-only rule marginal (~1 SE below bar) |
| **96** | **0.990** | ✓ **k\* = 96** |
| 128 (**d·ctx/32**) | 0.995 | ✓ passes but is NOT minimal |
| 192/256/384 | 0.995/0.999/0.998 | ✓ (384: loss 5.1356 ≈ full) |

Random-k: k=64 0.915 (gap +6.4), k=128 0.958 (gap +3.7). Concentration: eff support 177.80 (d=8: 50.16→91.49→177.80, ×1.82/×1.94), top-64 0.634, top-128 0.806, per-position 23.09/156.01/332.15 — no bounded working set.

## What this decides

1. **Single-lever rules REFUTED** — k=32 fails by 18 SE, k=64 sits on the bar. Depth demonstrably raises the required k above the d=4 context-only value (64): the levers act **multiplicatively**.
2. **But the exact product value 128 is not the minimum** — the knee lands at 96, 25% below d·ctx/32. The law is a **proven-safe upper bound** at high (depth × context): over-pruneable, never under (512/96 = **5.3×** actually available vs the guaranteed 4×).
3. **Sub-linear depth leg at long context** — at ctx=512, doubling d (4→8) raises k\* 64→96 = ×1.5, not the ×2.0 linear law (exact at ctx=128 across d=4/8/16). Cross-depth retained shift confirms the direction robustly: at k=64, retained drops 0.983/0.985 (d=4 ctx=512, two seeds) → 0.979 (d=8), ≈3 SE. Mechanism: retrieval load shared across the deeper stack at long context.

## Barriers

(a) clean — prediction stated before the run; the result DEVIATES, so it cannot be self-fulfilling; (b) clean — Catalog re-scan: no depth×context product-form/knee/top-k prior work (closest pkg 677, orthogonal); (c) confronted — high corner of the law's grid, real causal word LM, 4097 vocab, held-out loss+acc; (d) clean (held-out last-10%, data-free top-k); (e) **honest limit** — single-seed AND soft knee (k=64 ~1 SE below bar): the ROBUST claims are the single-lever refutation (−18 SE) and the depth right-shift of the retained curve (≈3 SE), NOT the exact coefficient 96; the sub-linear-depth claim needs a second seed at this corner; (f) clean — same metrics/protocol, k=384 converges to full loss, binom SE ≈0.15%; (g) fair — full-attention reference + random-k at same k, same bar; (h) strengthened — the deployable ≥4×-at-d=8 claim holds with margin (5.3× actually available).

## Verdict

**PRODUCT FORM CONFIRMED, EXACT KNEE REVISED** — the discriminating corner refutes both single-lever rules and confirms the levers multiply, but the exact knee (96) is 25% below d·ctx/32: the law is a safe upper bound at high (depth × context), and its depth leg is sub-linear at long context. Next (highest value): **d=8 ctx=512 second seed** — closes the sub-linear-depth claim's single-seed status.

Round-net-38. Now 38 network experiments. Assessment v38. Paper 82.
